view_claims.claim: Pydantic v2's model_copy(update=...) creates a copied model without validating the supplied update values.
SQLite permits one simultaneous write transaction, and BEGIN IMMEDIATE requests a write transaction immediately and may fail with SQLITE_BUSY when another writer is active.
A SQLite trigger can terminate an UPDATE or DELETE statement with RAISE(ABORT, message), returning a constraint error.
Python 3.12's standard-library hashlib provides a guaranteed sha256 constructor and hexadecimal digest output.
RFC 8785 canonical JSON sorts object property names by UTF-16 code units and encodes the resulting serialization as UTF-8.
